messages.text:
What it is: Every current-roster role's context is cleared at its own safe idle boundary, not just the coordinator's
What it solves: BL-309 shipped the coordinator-only slice of this intake and explicitly
left the rest for later: "Write the idle/safe-boundary predicate
generically (reusable), but wire and verify only the coordinator's
clear-after-close in this ticket — extending to other roles is a future
ticket, not this one." …
How it works: Any current-roster role that just completed a task/batch and is idle gets a /clear injected followed by the startup re-read instruction
